artificial_intelligence.title: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
artificial_intelligence.description: Our AI research and engineering team develops state-of-the-art models for perception, planning, and human-robot interaction. We combine classical robotics with modern deep learning to create truly intelligent machines.

capabilities.description: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs), transformers, and recurrent architectures optimized for real-time robotic inference on edge devices.
Model-based and model-free RL for robot control, navigation, and manipulation. Training in simulation with sim-to-real transfer.
Transformer-based language models fine-tuned for robotic command understanding and multi-turn dialogue in 30+ languages.
Large language models and diffusion models for task planning, code generation, and robot behavior synthesis.
applications: Automated task planning from natural language

computer_vision.title: Computer Vision
computer_vision.description: Our vision systems enable robots to see, understand, and interact with their environment in real time. From 3D perception to facial recognition, our CV stack runs efficiently on embedded hardware.

capabilities.description: Stereo vision, structured light, and LiDAR-camera fusion for accurate 3D environment mapping and object localization.
Real-time multi-object detection and tracking using YOLOv8 and transformer-based detectors, optimized for edge deployment.
Privacy-preserving facial recognition for personalized robot interactions. Hand and body gesture recognition for intuitive human-robot communication.
technologies: Privacy-first: on-device only, no cloud upload

capabilities.description: Automated visual inspection for manufacturing quality control — defect detection, dimensional measurement, and surface analysis.

robotics_engineering.title: Robotics Engineering
robotics_engineering.description: Core robotics capabilities spanning kinematics, dynamics, control theory, and mechatronics design.

capabilities.description: Advanced trajectory planning and real-time control for manipulators and mobile platforms.
Simultaneous Localization and Mapping for autonomous navigation in unknown and dynamic environments.
Robotic grasping and manipulation for diverse objects in unstructured environments.
Custom actuator design, sensor integration, and embedded electronics for our robot platforms.

edge_computing.title: Edge AI & Computing
edge_computing.description: All our AI inference runs on-device for low latency, privacy, and offline capability. We design custom edge computing hardware optimized for robotic workloads.

platforms.name: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Integration
platforms.description: Our primary edge AI platform. Custom-optimized models run on Jetson Orin AGX (275 TOPS) and Orin NX (100 TOPS).

platforms.name: Chikku Edge AI Accelerator
platforms.description: Custom FPGA-based accelerator for ultra-low-latency perception tasks (< 5ms inference). Optimized for safety-critical real-time applications.

platforms.name: On-Device LLM
platforms.description: Quantized language models (4-bit, 8-bit) running locally on robot hardware. Enables private, offline conversational AI without cloud dependency.

cloud_platform.title: Cloud & Data Platform
cloud_platform.description: Our cloud infrastructure supports fleet management, continuous learning, and data analytics across thousands of deployed robots.

capabilities.description: Monitor, control, and optimize robot fleets at scale. Real-time telemetry, task assignment, and traffic management.
Physics-accurate simulation of robots and environments. Test new behaviors, validate safety, and train AI models in simulation before deployment.
Federated learning pipeline that improves robot AI models using field data while preserving privacy. Models improve with every deployment.
Operational analytics dashboard showing robot utilization, efficiency metrics, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance alerts.

safety_systems.title: Safety & Certification
safety_systems.description: Safety is the foundation of all our technology. We implement multi-layered safety architectures and comply with international robotics safety standards.
standards: ISO 13482 — Safety requirements for personal care robots
ISO 13849 — Safety-related parts of control systems (up to PL e / SIL 3)
IEC 61508 — Functional safety of electrical/electronic systems
safety_features: Multi-layer safety: hardware safety controller + software safety monitor
Force-limited joints with real-time collision detection
360° LiDAR-based safety zones with configurable protective fields
Fail-safe braking on all mobile platforms
Redundant light detection and ranging for outdoor vehicles
